libarchive.js 2.0.2 (npm "libarchive.js", https://github.com/nika-begiashvili/libarchivejs)
Files: libarchive.js is the package's unchanged dist/libarchive.js.
worker-bundle.js and libarchive.wasm are rebuilt from source with
libarchive 3.8.11 by build/build.sh (2026-11-23; the 2.0.2 package shipped
libarchive 3.7.2). The rebuild is byte for byte reproducible with the same
Emscripten (emcc 7.0.1). sha256:
  libarchive.js     7948329343f4039e3088bb9818af96b2e70fc7dac8a43b878ced4314de0c8f2a
  worker-bundle.js  bd56d13b368b7ba70e6edbd52cf8511835adabc037f76340a3f03c62e4f51db8
  libarchive.wasm   82cbf711e8fcacc1f682809289e504d110362f04bc47dadf9883c6615d742e8b
Used by orOS Library only to open CBR (RAR) comics; loaded on demand, never for
other books.

The JavaScript wrapper is under the MIT License (LICENSE in this folder,
Copyright (c) 2018 Nika Begiashvili).

The WebAssembly module and the worker bundle also contain:
